settings.heading: Born in Dubai. Composed in the French tradition.

settings.text: XplorScent exists to make fine fragrance an everyday pleasure. Our debut collection captures the mysterious allure of the Middle East with the elegance of French artistry.

Xplor Scent was founded by Nadim Razaq, a lifelong fragrance enthusiast with a sharp creative vision. After a successful career in the IT industry, Nadim followed his long-standing love for perfumery and the emotional power of scent — how it can evoke, stir memories and create lasting impressions.

Driven by the idea that luxury should be accessible, he built a brand on craftsmanship, quality, and a mission to make fine fragrance an everyday pleasure: elegance made attainable.

settings.heading: Rare oud, bright citrus, refined florals

settings.text: Each eau de parfum is composed at high concentration for lasting wear — built around note pyramids that reveal themselves through the day, from the first spark of bergamot to the final trace of oud wood.
